_comment: Shot list for the trailer as Brian mixed it. No new paintings: every still comes from episodes 1 to 5, so the trailer looks like what a viewer will find when they click through. 'from' is the section id in scripts/trailermix_02.txt.
style: As the episodes: painterly, warm light, no faces close up, no text in the image, no modern objects, 16:9.

shots.description: A lone man walks down a steep, narrow stone street in Jerusalem, one hand on the wall, seen from behind.
A man stands on the grass with his back to us, arms lifted a little, looking out at the whole Sea of Galilee in clear light.
A whole crowd on the Jericho road stands still, turned toward one figure at its centre, while a beggar at the edge begins to rise.
An open scroll in warm light, for the Scripture read word for word.

shots.at_phrase: You will hear about the place
shots.description: Wide stone steps in sets of five, descending to the still water of the Pool of Siloam.

shots.at_phrase: And you will be asked to imagine.
shots.description: An imagined scene begins. Two hands mixing earth into mud on a paving stone.

shots.at_phrase: I have sat at the top of this road
shots.description: The man on the steep street again, his hand on the wall.
Two people on a crowded stepped street, walking down against the flow, one holding the other's arm.

shots.at_phrase: But I am going to find out
shots.description: A man kneels at the edge of the pool, seen from behind, ripples spreading from his hands.
A photograph treated to match the paintings: Brian as a young sailor in Navy whites, with Patti beside him. A small plate beneath him reads Mister Scaredy Cat.
A white cane leaning against a church pew in window light. Brian speaks.

shots.at_phrase: I did not expect how often the blind are there
shots.description: In the Temple court, among overturned tables, people come forward led by the hand, on a crutch, and feeling the way with a staff.
The white cane and the pew again.
A great crowd along the crest of a hill above the Sea of Galilee, arms raised, climbers on the path below.
Two men follow a crowd down a narrow lane in Capernaum, one with a hand on the other's shoulder.
The open scroll. For we walk by faith, not by sight.

shots.card:
For we walk by faith, not by sight.
2 Corinthians 5:7

blindnessinthebible.com
shots.description: Closing card over Jerusalem at dusk: For we walk by faith, not by sight. The site address.
